written.name: round 1 rival 1
written.comment: Anger meter: insults add 2, apologies subtract 1, gifts do nothing; warm iff anger <= 0.

written.name: round 1 rival 2
written.comment: Trust meter: insults subtract 1, apologies and gifts add 1; warm iff trust > 0.

written.name: round 1 rival 3
written.comment: Grudge rule: cold if the first action is insult, or if two insults occur consecutively; otherwise warm.

written.name: round 1 rival 4
written.comment: Insult-count rule: cold if the first action is insult, or if there are at least two insults total; otherwise warm.

written.name: round 2 rival 1
written.comment: Warm when apologies strictly outnumber insults; gifts are ignored.

written.name: round 2 rival 2
written.comment: Score = 2*(apologies - insults) + gifts; warm when score is at least 1.

written.name: round 2 rival 3
written.comment: Score = 4*apologies - 3*insults; warm when score is at least 3. Gifts are ignored.

written.name: round 2 rival 4
written.comment: Warm if apologies outnumber insults, or if the last action was an apology and apologies+gifts outnumber insults.

written.name: round 3 rival 1
written.comment: Warm iff trust (apology/gift +1, insult -1) is positive and the last action was not an insult.

written.name: round 3 rival 2
written.comment: Warm iff -2*insults + apologies + gifts is positive and the last action was not an insult.

written.name: round 3 rival 3
written.comment: Warm iff trust is positive and no insult remains unapologised; gifts add trust but do not forgive insults.

written.name: round 3 rival 4
written.comment: Warm iff -3*insults + 2*apologies + gifts is positive, and either there were fewer than 2 insults or the last action was an apology.

survivors.name: round 3 rival 2
survivors.comment: Warm iff -2*insults + apologies + gifts is positive and the last action was not an insult.

survivors.name: round 3 rival 3
survivors.comment: Warm iff trust is positive and no insult remains unapologised; gifts add trust but do not forgive insults.

shown the survivors.comment: Warm iff trust is positive and no insult remains unapologised; gifts add trust but do not forgive insults.

shown the facts only.comment: Robin keeps a hidden grudge count: insult +1, apologise -1 (minimum 0), gift no effect; mood is warm only when the count is 0.
